description: React component providing context and functions for managing card details, including adding and deleting blocks within a card in a web application.

classes.name: AddedBlock
classes.description: Type representing a block added to a card, with its ID and whether it was auto-added.

classes.name: CardDetailContextType
classes.description: Type defining the context object for card detail operations, including the card, last added block, and functions to add or delete blocks.

classes.name: CardDetailProps
classes.description: Type for properties passed to the CardDetailProvider component, including the card and children elements.

methods.name: useCardDetailContext
methods.description: Custom hook to access the CardDetailContext, throws error if context is unavailable.

methods.name: CardDetailProvider
methods.description: React component that provides card detail context, including functions to add and delete blocks within a card.
